must: Use the evsel experience as the primary / homepage; keep /endustriyel as the separate industrial branch and redirect the legacy /evsel route to /.
Use the existing Tailwind v3 brand tokens, Manrope headings, Inter body copy, and real logo assets.
Keep approved evsel homepage copy and verified business facts as the source of truth.
Search 21st.dev before hand-writing new UI and adapt selected patterns to existing project primitives.
Meet mobile-first, keyboard, visible-focus, reduced-motion, semantic HTML, and 44px touch-target requirements.

Use only verified trust claims. Placeholder product names, specs, and images may appear only when visibly labeled as representative draft catalog content; never use them as proof, SEO claims, or conversion promises.
avoid: Do not introduce shadcn token names or Tailwind v4 utilities into this Tailwind v3 non-shadcn project.
Do not replace the approved homepage copy or disrupt existing user changes.
Avoid generic AI landing-page aesthetics: excessive gradients, glass, cards, huge headlines, or decorative motion.
Avoid dark heavy page sections except for purposeful proof or CTA anchors already supported by the design system.
Do not fabricate testimonials, ratings, savings, capacities, project counts, awards, guarantees, or model specifications.

decisions.decision: Google Ads landing direction: Kanıt İlk Ekranda (proof-first)
decisions.reason: The +35 audience should see service-region fit, free discovery, verified awards, phone, and WhatsApp before deeper product exploration.

decisions.decision: Service details use one config-driven dynamic template with four seeded slugs
decisions.reason: Content can be updated centrally while each route retains distinct SEO/GEO metadata, scope, products, proof, field work, and FAQs.

decisions.decision: Short lead forms prepare a WhatsApp message and do not persist submitted data
decisions.reason: This supports the requested phone + WhatsApp + form flow without introducing an unapproved backend or silent data collection.

decisions.decision: Sahadan uses an evidence-methodology page with an explicit empty archive and separately labeled representative imagery
decisions.reason: No permissioned case records exist yet, so gallery composition must not imply that stock imagery is project proof.

decisions.decision: Contact uses local-channel cards, two physical locations, and the shared WhatsApp draft form
decisions.reason: The +35 audience can choose phone, WhatsApp, or a short assisted form while business identity and data flow remain clear.

decisions.decision: Routes open at the top unless the URL contains an intentional hash target
decisions.reason: Browser scroll restoration was carrying prior footer positions into newly opened pages; explicit anchors must continue to work.

decisions.decision: The evsel experience is the canonical homepage and /evsel permanently redirects to /
decisions.reason: The selection gateway is retired so visitors and search engines enter through one primary residential landing URL without duplicate content.

decisions.decision: EvselFooter is the universal footer across all rendered site pages
decisions.reason: A single shared footer keeps navigation, trust copy, locations, phone, WhatsApp, and legal links consistent across residential, industrial, product, service, contact, landing, and legal routes.

decisions.decision: About photo cards use bottom-to-top dark gradient overlays instead of backdrop blur
decisions.reason: The gradient preserves text contrast while keeping award and field imagery sharp and visible behind the copy.

decisions.decision: Homepage product cards share the verified brand catalog and use phone-first discovery plus brand-detail actions
decisions.reason: A single catalog source keeps Bosch, NIBE, Gram Power, and Varmeks model names and imagery synchronized across homepage and detail routes.

decisions.decision: The universal footer contact column includes compact icon links for Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube
decisions.reason: Social destinations remain discoverable beside the primary phone and WhatsApp channels without competing with them.

decisions.decision: Verified achievement cards on the product hub show the real award photography above the brand and result copy
decisions.reason: The physical award is stronger visual evidence than a logo-only card while the lower text panel preserves fast comparison.

decisions.decision: The product hub marquee presents transparent PNG product cutouts directly on the hero surface without card containers
decisions.reason: Removing white cards, borders, radii, and shadows keeps the moving band visually light and lets the product silhouettes remain the focus.

decisions.decision: The product hub reuses the homepage's filterable product carousel instead of a separate brand-summary grid
decisions.reason: One shared component keeps product imagery, model copy, filters, discovery actions, and brand-detail links consistent across the homepage and product hub.

decisions.decision: The product hub places selection steps and the discovery CTA directly after award proof, followed by the product carousel
decisions.reason: Visitors first see verified credibility, then understand the assisted selection process and receive a clear contact action before browsing individual products; the redundant decision-guide cards are removed.

decisions.decision: The product hero removes its eyebrow, uses a two-line home-system headline, and pairs discovery with a direct product-scroll action
decisions.reason: The simplified hierarchy makes the core promise dominant while giving visitors an immediate choice between contacting the team and browsing the catalog.

decisions.decision: The services hub opens with an animated two-column hero pairing existing service copy and contact actions with a restrained three-image field collage
decisions.reason: The collage gives the broad service offer a tangible technical context while verified experience, branch, and service-region facts remain visible beside the primary actions.

decisions.decision: The services hero omits breadcrumb and eyebrow labels so the primary heading opens the content directly
decisions.reason: Removing two stacked navigation labels simplifies the hero hierarchy and reduces unused vertical space beneath the persistent navigation.

decisions.decision: The services hero collage shows only the three photographs without decorative shapes, visible labels, frames, backgrounds, or shadows
decisions.reason: A frameless collage keeps the technical imagery visually quiet and prevents ornamental UI from competing with the service message.

decisions.decision: The services hub removes the separate suitability-routing card section
decisions.reason: The primary four-service cards already provide scope previews and detail links, making the second routing grid repetitive before the shared process section.

decisions.decision: The service lead area removes its decorative wrench and groups a 'Bizi Ara' action beside the WhatsApp draft submit button
decisions.reason: Keeping both response channels at the form's decision point reduces visual noise and prevents the phone action from being separated from the primary WhatsApp workflow.

decisions.decision: Each primary service card includes a distinct full-width contextual image above its existing icon and service details
decisions.reason: The visual headers make installation, mechanical work, project planning, and maintenance easier to distinguish while preserving the established card hierarchy and actions.

decisions.decision: The Sahadan route uses a full bento-style field gallery with an accessible lightbox, followed by the homepage's Instagram video strip
decisions.reason: A visual-first archive makes field stages easier to explore while the reused social content provides a separate stream of permissioned real videos and interviews; representative gallery imagery remains explicitly labeled.

decisions.decision: Brand catalogs group verified residential heat pumps, hot-water products, system units, and pool products by use category while commercial products feed only the industrial catalog
decisions.reason: The shared source of truth keeps every official product family available without presenting commercial capacities as household products.

decisions.decision: The heat-pump installation service page reuses verified award plates and the existing Instagram field-video carousel
decisions.reason: The service detail gains real visual proof without introducing a parallel component language or unverified project claims.

decisions.decision: Industrial proof statistics use a cool-blue-to-teal brand gradient without the orange endpoint
decisions.reason: The cool-only gradient keeps the dark CTA panel calm while retaining the brand's dimensional accent treatment.

decisions.decision: Local heat-pump intent is served through one browseable regions hub and four evidence-oriented location pages
decisions.reason: Bandırma, Balıkesir, Çanakkale, and Bursa pages each expose distinct discovery logistics, local checks, districts, pricing factors, and buyer questions instead of thin city-name doorway copies.

decisions.decision: Region pages share a proof-to-selection sequence using the existing About award bento and Finder
decisions.reason: One dynamic template keeps verified award imagery, founder context, capacity guidance, and WhatsApp discovery consistent while city-specific copy and location context remain unique on each page.

decisions.decision: Blog uses footer-only navigation, the shared page hero and a restrained article reading layout
decisions.reason: Editorial content remains separate from primary sales navigation. Empty states, draft exclusion, a development-only preview, and publication-driven metadata let content be added later without indexing placeholders.
